author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Mandalorian and Grogu performed even worse than expected, and is on track to be a box office bomb. Meanwhile, Obsession turned a low budget indy film into a box office juggernaut. And Supergirl is projected to perform like The Marvels. Ouch! Join me, MauLer, Disparu, Reaper and Fringy for Open Bar #186!
